name: Leadplant
desc: Leadplant (Amorpha canescens): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 6 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Amorpha canescens, known as leadplant, downy indigo bush, prairie shoestring, or buffalo bellows, is a small, perennial semi-shrub in the pea family (Fabaceae), native to North America.
